newsitem.title: CHINA: SHENZHEN B SHARES CLOSE UP SLIGHTLY, TRADE SLOW.
newsitem.headline: SHENZHEN B SHARES CLOSE UP SLIGHTLY, TRADE SLOW.

text.p: Shenzhen's hard currency B share index ended minimally higher in dull trading on Thursday, helped by institutional support just before the close, brokers said.
They said they expected the index to move at current levels in the short term due to an absence of new incentives.
The index inched up 0.03 points or 0.02 percent to 129.99 on turnover of HK$45 million against HK$46 million on Wednesday.
The domestic A share index gained 3.87 points or 0.96 percent to 407.39 on turnover of 4.4 billion yuan against 4.0 billion yuan in the previous session.

A spurt of buying of Beijing Orient Electronics just before the market closed helped to lift the B share index, brokers said. It closed up HK$0.03 to HK$3.95 on heavy volume of 1.6 million shares. The company on Monday posted a 29 percent year-on-year jump in its 1997 interim net profits, which reached 68.72 million yuan under international accounting standards.
Only two of the 49 Shenzhen-listed B share companies have released 1997 interim results despite an August 30 deadline.
Brokers said the B share market has been dominated by a wait-and-see mood with investors sidelined, expecting a flood of reports in the near future.
"Despite the rise, sentiment in the market did not improve," an analyst at J&A Securities (HK) said. "The index is expected to hold steady in the near future."
"The market is still in the process of a correction," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said.
Shenzhen Nanshan Power Station was the best performer, rising HK$0.24 or 5.21 percent to HK$4.85 on volume 439,901 shares.
Bengang Steel was the most actively traded on volume of 1.77 million shares, putting on a meagre HK$0.01 to HK$2.10 against its recent offer price of HK$2.38.
The A share market's advance was founded in part on institutional demand for large-capitalised as well as low-priced counters, brokers said.
Garment maker Sichuan Tiange put in the most solid performance, surging 0.45 yuan or 8.77 percent to 5.58 yuan.
Recently-listed Yantian Harbour jumped 0.37 yuan to 12.91 yuan after 15 million shares changed hands. It was the session's most actively traded counter.
